text:
hana: kicked off zeppelin-int6 bring-up on staging. running standard holdout + cluster sanity. dropping notes here.

hana: run:
```bash
./eval_embeddings --model zeppelin-int6 --holdout holdout_v4 --metrics recall@1,recall@5,silhouette --calib 25k
```

ci-bot: eval job 7733 done — R@1: 0.421, R@5: 0.758, silhouette: 0.48
ci-bot: baseline (zeppelin-int8) — R@1: 0.447, R@5: 0.796, silhouette: 0.51

tomas: ~3.8% abs drop at R@5. where is pull-down concentrated?

hana: short queries (<7 tokens) worst; support-like templates show highest idflip. UMAP shows tighter clusters but more mixing at boundaries.

lee: which quant recipe? per-channel asymmetric?

hana: per-channel asym with calibr 25k random. also tried L2-normalize after quant.

lee: try stratified calibr emphasising templates and per-axis rescale to match int8 norm mean. also dump top1 neighbor diffs for 3k queries.

hana: launched job 7734 (stratified calib 100k, per-axis rescale, idflip dump).

ci-bot: job 7734 finished partial — R@5: 0.782, short-query top1 idflip 8.6%

tomas: good improvement. gate: aim <1% abs R@5 delta and idflip <7% for short queries before canary.

hana: agreed. I'll run a 5% record-only canary after one more pass with 200k stratified calib. will open ticket ML-1210 with job ids [7733,7734].
